assets.name: coast
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: immersive cinematic backdrop for an original private cinema app, also cropped as a fictional film poster titled The Quiet Coast. Generate a breathtaking widescreen 16:9 film still, no text. Wild Atlantic coast at blue hour, towering dark cliffs along the right edge, a tiny lone figure in a rust-red coat on the right third overlooking luminous pale silver ocean, low rolling fog, pale apricot light fading at the horizon. Shot on 35mm film, subtle analog grain, natural dramatic light, rich blue-green shadows, exquisite fine photographic detail, editorial art-house cinematography. Broad dark ocean negative space on the left 45 percent reserved for large white UI text; distinct rugged cliff and person on the right. No letters, no typography, no borders, no watermarks. This is original fictional film artwork.
